| **`mkdir`** | Create a new directory. | `dir_name` |
| **`mv`** | Move/rename file or directory. | `source`, `destination` |
| **`pwd`** | Show current working directory. | – |
| **`rm`** | Remove a file. | `file_name` |

| **`sort`** | Sort file lines. | `file_name` |
| **`tail`** | Show last lines of a file. | `file_name`, `lines?` |
